deliverables.title: Remote Work Abroad & Cross-Border Compliance Analysis
deliverables.subject: Compliance Assessment: Overseas Remote Work Schedule
deliverables.content:
### Policy Analysis: Remote Working Overseas (REQ-1037)

**Case Overview:** Employee Alex Johnson requested 3 weeks of remote work from Spain during winter break.

**Policy Evaluation:**
- **Handbook Section 3.2 (International Remote Cadence):** Permits up to 20 business days per calendar year in eligible jurisdictions.
- **Tax & Legal Risk:** Spain has a 30-day bilateral treaty grace period; 15 working days poses zero permanent establishment (PE) risk.
- **Infrastructure Security:** Mandates hardware token VPN authentication.

**Recommendation:** Approve remote work agreement with standard security stipulations.

deliverables.title: Overtime Allocation & Workload Disparity Investigation Summary
deliverables.subject: Internal HR Case Summary: Workload Disparity Grievance
deliverables.content:
### Confidential Investigation Summary: REQ-1014

**Grievance:** Employee reported unequal overtime allocation during fiscal quarter-end close.

**Findings:**
1. Overtime records across the financial analysis team for Q3 show a 28% variance between team members.
2. Workload scheduling was managed ad-hoc without rotation logs.

**Proposed Remediation:**
- Establish formalized rotation roster for month-end close.
- HR Specialist Marcus Vance to facilitate a 1-on-1 alignment session.
